title: workspace.console.prepare
description: A task's worktree, clean at its HEAD, and the guard taken before the run (console_run.py): a console producer's, or the Developer's tools' with private_git false. A failure is `ok: false` with `error`.

workspace_root.description: An absolute path on the daemon's machine.

forge_policy.description: The company's forge policy (issue #727, PROTOCOL.md section 5.3). Missing or unknown reads as none; capped by the daemon's FORGE_POLICY_MAX.

private_git.description: false: the worktree keeps git's own pointer and gets no private repository, for the Developer's tools on a task's first attempt (PROTOCOL.md section 5.1.5, announced as the private_git feature). Missing or true: a console producer's private repository, as before.
